inspect.blocked: Blocked for security: we do not follow links to internal destinations.

inspect.blocked.port: Blocked: only ports 80, 443, 8080 and 8443 are allowed.

input.multiple-urls: There were several URLs; only the first one was used.
input.scheme-assumed: It had no scheme; https:// was assumed.
parse.warning.backslash: It contains backslashes (\). Browsers read them as normal slashes, but other programs may not.
parse.warning.control-chars: It contained line breaks or tabs, which were removed.
parse.warning.numeric-ipv4: The IP address is written in an unusual form; browsers read it as {host}.

clean.reason.campaign: Identifies the marketing campaign you came from.
clean.reason.ad-click: Identifies your click on an ad so the ad platform can attribute it.
clean.reason.email: Identifies the email and the person who opened it.
clean.reason.analytics: Used to link your visit across analytics tools.
clean.reason.social: Records who shared the link or where from.
clean.reason.affiliate: Affiliate or referral marker; it does not change the content.
clean.reason.wrapper: It was a {platform} redirect; the real destination has been extracted.

explain.part.scheme.https: https: the connection to the site is encrypted.
explain.part.scheme.http: http: the connection is not encrypted; others on the network could see it.
explain.part.scheme.dangerous: {scheme}: it does not open a web page; it can run code or show embedded content.
explain.part.scheme.other: {scheme}: not a web page; another app opens it.
explain.part.userinfo: Embedded username or password. They are not part of the site you are going to.
explain.part.host: The server the browser connects to.
explain.part.registrable-domain: The real site: whoever controls this domain controls the page.
explain.part.subdomain: Subdomain: a section chosen by the owner of {domain}.
explain.part.port: Port {port}: a "door" other than the server's usual one.
explain.part.path: The path: which page or resource is requested within the site.
explain.part.param.tracking: {name}: a {platform} tracking parameter. It does not change the content.
explain.part.param.functional: {name}: a parameter the site may use to show the content.
explain.part.fragment: The fragment: a position within the page. It is not sent to the server.
explain.signal.userinfo-deception: What comes before @ ({shown}) is not the destination. The real site is {real}.
explain.signal.ip-host: The destination is an IP address instead of a domain name.
explain.signal.homograph: The domain uses letters from another alphabet that look Latin. Its real form is {ascii}.
explain.signal.mixed-scripts: The domain mixes different alphabets. Its real form is {ascii}.
explain.signal.excessive-encoding: It has a lot of percent-encoding, which can hide what it really says.
explain.signal.double-encoding: It is double-encoded (%25…), a common way to hide content.
explain.signal.dangerous-scheme: The {scheme} scheme can run code or show content without opening a website.
explain.signal.unusual-port: It uses port {port}, which is unusual for public sites.
explain.signal.abuse-tld: The domain ends in .{tld}, an ending often used in abuse campaigns. It does not mean this site is one.
